title: ReleaseEvidenceManifest (exact artifact-bound release gate)
$comment: Structural residue of the release.* rules (P0-7). One manifest per release subject: the exact output digest (release.subject.exact-digest) with every piece of evidence — build inputs, toolchain, scans, SBOM, provenance, waivers, decision — bound to that digest (release.evidence.subject-binding). The ArtifactSBOMReference and BuildProvenanceReference artifacts from the decision ledger live here as $defs (sbomReference / provenanceReference); they are reference shapes, not standalone files. $defs are inlined (no cross-file $ref).

subjectType.$comment: An oci-image-index subject additionally enumerates platformManifests (release.pin.image-digest).

platformManifests.$comment: Required when subjectType is oci-image-index; each member is a scan subject of its own (release.scan.coverage).

sourceCommit.$comment: Full commit SHA (release.pin.source-exact). A locator, not the release identity.

buildWorkflowRef.$comment: Repository / workflow path / action SHAs the release ran under (release.pin.action-sha); the provenance verifier pins the same fields independently (release.provenance.trusted-builder).

toolchain.$comment: Tested-is-shipped evidence (release.toolchain.tested-is-shipped): the tested and shipped versions are recorded and equal.

pin.$comment: Digest / version pin, or the literal 'unpinned' — enumerating an unpinned input is what keeps IMMUTABLE_ARTIFACT and REPRODUCIBLE_BUILD separate claims (release.claim.reproducible-separate).

waiverIds.$comment: References into release-waiver.json artifacts; the count surfaces in the headline (release.headline.policy-id).

reproduction.$comment: Second-build evidence for REPRODUCIBLE_BUILD@1 (release.claim.reproducible-separate): an independent clean builder deriving the same digest. reproducedDigest matching subjectDigest is a semantic check (vector-pinned), not expressible here.

decision.$comment: The policy outcome; findings stay recorded as evidence regardless (release.decision.evidence-separated).

claims.$comment: The release claims actually asserted. A baseline-gate release asserts at most IMMUTABLE_ARTIFACT@1 (release.claim.baseline-cap).

policyVersion.$comment: The versioned public release profile in force (release.profile.versioned).

allOf.$comment: An index subject without its per-platform manifests lets one architecture ship unscanned (release.pin.image-digest / release.scan.coverage).
TRUSTED_SUPPLY_CHAIN rides on verified provenance (release.claim.baseline-cap); a manifest claiming it must carry the provenance references it was verified from.
REPRODUCIBLE_BUILD needs the enumerated build-input closure the second builder consumed (release.claim.reproducible-separate).

decimalString.$comment: canon.number.safe-integer: a count in the string domain, not a JSON number.

scanArtifact.$comment: release.scan.artifact-fields + release.scan.state-machine: one scan of one subject surface.

coverage.$comment: release.scan.coverage: the enumerated surfaces; a surface with no scan artifact was not covered.

state.$comment: release.scan.state-machine: error states never project to zero advisories.

findingRefs.$comment: References into advisory-assessment.json artifacts when state is FINDINGS.

sbomReference.$comment: ArtifactSBOMReference (release.sbom.subject-bound): the SBOM binding, generator identity, and coverage — generation alone grounds no completeness claim.

provenanceReference.$comment: BuildProvenanceReference (release.provenance.trusted-builder / .per-ecosystem): the pinned verification fields; an attestation matching fewer fields is rejected.
